name: synthflow-mcp
description: Connects Claude Code to the Synthflow AI voice-agent platform through its hosted MCP server, with skills for reviewing calls and auditing agent prompts, plus a docs-search connector.

mcp_url.title: Synthflow MCP server URL
mcp_url.description: Use the endpoint matching your workspace region (Admin → Workspace Settings → Preferences → Customer Region): Global https://mcp.synthflow.ai/mcp · US https://mcp.us.synthflow.ai/mcp · EU https://mcp.eu.synthflow.ai/mcp
